text:
inc-bot: PAGER -> Serving runtime: multi-GPU collective failures detected on prod-gpu-1.0. Severity: P1. Symptoms: repeated NCCL ALLREDUCE hang + Xid errors, containers restarting. Paging @oncall. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/rb/collective-hang

mike: saw the pager, I'm on it. pinging infra to freeze any rolling deploys.

ana: @mike noted - paused model rollout for prod-gpu-1.0 via control plane.

mike: first look: GPU host 10.2.3.57 showing repeated `Xid 31` then `Xid 79` in dmesg, then container `inference-worker` OOM-killed.

raj: adding logs to thread: `dmesg | tail -n 50` showed:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid 79: GPU at 0000:81:00:00: PID 4231: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 12345.679012] watchdog: task <worker> blocked for more than 120 seconds.
[ 12346.000000] oom-killer: killing process 4231 (python) score 945
```

lee: on the NCCL side, `nccl-tests` run by ops shows `AllReduce: hang at step 8/1000` with communicator ID `nccl_0x7f` on 4 GPUs.

mike: taking node 10.2.3.57 OOB: cordoning node to prevent new schedules: `kubectl cordon gpu-prod-57`

dana: @mike recommend immediate container restart on affected nodes and draining any in-progress tensor/pipeline jobs. Also capture the KV cache dump and NCCL debug logs.

mike: capturing logs: `kubectl logs -n infra inference-worker -p --since=10m` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu --format=csv -l 1` running.

raj: FYI seeing repeated `NCCL WARN Unhandled operation` + `NCCL INFO: communicator reset` in `/var/log/runtime/nccl.log` around the time. Might be a driver/kernel mismatch after the latest host kernel update.

lee: can someone confirm driver version? `nvidia-smi` shows `Driver Version: 535.54.03` on healthy nodes but `530.41.03` on 10.2.3.57 - mismatch.

ana: oh — that explains the falloff. We had a partial kernel-driver rollout overnight. ops-runbook says mismatch can cause Xid 79.

mike: mitigation plan: 1) move in-flight requests to fallback model variant in dedicated pool; 2) cordon + reboot node after capturing full logs; 3) pin driver versions cluster-wide; 4) run NCCL health check after reboot.

dana: executing step 1: triggering routing policy -> `reroute --cluster prod-gpu-1.0 --to dedicated-pool --filter model:small` (started). Notifying customers about degraded performance.

raj: started `kubectl exec` into pod to dump KV cache and collect `/tmp/kvcache.dump` + `nccl_info` with `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO`. Uploading to ops bucket.

mike: I've notified SRE manager and started on-call handoff docs. Logging the incident in JIRA: INC-2026-1789.

inc-bot: Incident bridge created: https://zoom.internal/bridges/3795012345.ops. Bridge pinned to thread.

lee: quick workaround: forcing `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1` on workers prevented immediate hang in test replica but not a permanent fix.

dana: customer impact: several small-model requests experienced 2-6s extra latency, large pipeline jobs timed out and were retried. We have one customer (acme-corp) reporting errors for batch inference, filing support ticket now.

ana: support note drafted: short mitigation steps and ETA for full recovery (node reboot + driver sync).

mike: reboot scheduled for node 10.2.3.57 in 5min after final log sync. Will coordinate with infra to apply driver 535.54.03.

raj: uploaded `kvcache.dump` and `nccl_debug.log` to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3795012345/ . Also grabbed `kubectl describe pod` outputs and `containerd` logs.

lee: after reboot, we should run `nccl-tests` with `-b 8 -e 512 -f 2` across the host to validate collective ops.

mike: node reboot done. reboots shows driver now `535.54.03`. restarting pods.

dana: post-reboot healthcheck running: 4/4 gpus pass `nccl-tests`, model worker logs show no NCCL WARN after 2 minutes.

mike: uncordoning node `kubectl uncordon gpu-prod-57` and allowing scheduling.

ana: rolling restart completed for the smaller batch jobs. Large pipeline jobs still being monitored, one job retried successfully.

inc-bot: Incident severity updated -> Monitoring. Auto-update scheduled for 30m.

dana: next steps for RCA: 1) identify why the driver rollout was partial; 2) add preflight check to detect driver/kernel mismatch before rolling; 3) add automatic model routing fallback when NCCL Xids exceed threshold.

raj: tagging logs and saving core dumps to forensics. Will open a postmortem draft and include timeline + command outputs.

mike: on-call handoff in 30m to @lee. I'll add a short notes block for next shift: what we did, which node, commands run, links to logs.

lee: taking handoff. noted. thanks team. :thumbsup:

mike: closing bridge in 45m if no regressions.

dana: customer update sent to ACME via support with ETA 2h for full cluster validation.

lee: filing post-incident follow-ups: deploy gating, driver pinning, alert tuning.

mike: thanks all. I'll drop the timeline into the postmortem and ping legal for impact review if needed.

inc-bot: Incident resolved -> Status: mitigated. Root cause pending RCA.
